sections.title: 01 · Workspace and AI terminal
sections.question: Can you follow the terminal request through assigned work and waiting tasks while still finding the existing dashboard views and actions you use?

sections.title: 02 · Planning and the task board
sections.question: Does the plan make dependencies, approval state and the next step clear without losing existing board controls or task history?

sections.title: 03 · Agent collaboration and evidence
sections.question: Can you distinguish an agent's report from verified evidence, understand the block and tell which messages the current user may see?

sections.title: 04 · Connected teams and routing decisions
sections.question: Are ownership, reserved work and unknown progress clear, and does the design explain Jev's advisory role and what happens when it abstains or is unavailable?

sections.title: 05 · Result review and acceptance
sections.question: Can you distinguish worker completion, evidence review and origin acceptance, and which dashboard review actions should be available through authorized services?

sections.title: 06 · Plugin tools and industrial operations
sections.question: Are package relationships and read-only permissions clear, including the separate authorization and environment checks needed before equipment changes?

sections.title: Overall notes
sections.question: Do the scenes keep worker completion, evidence, result submission and origin acceptance clearly separate? Note anything that blurs them, and any other overall feedback.
